tags.name: Pamilacan Island
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-21: All three sources re-fetched; sub-site details diverge more than the prior pass captured. SM Divers now rates Dakit-Dakit 'suitable for beginners and experienced divers' with 'leisurely drift dives' (contradicts its own site-level Advanced recommendation); Valm Divers rates Dakit-Dakit Intermediate-Advanced with 'mild to strong current.' Spanish Tower: SM Divers says 'advanced preferred, stronger currents' and lists manta rays, eagle rays, and seasonal whale sharks; Alona Divers' Pamilacan page explicitly states its content does NOT mention manta rays or whale sharks at any Pamilacan site; Valm Divers doesn't mention megafauna at Spanish Tower either. CORRECTION: markdown text rewritten to present this as an explicit source conflict per-sub-site rather than asserting uniform 'strong currents/exposed' — this is a genuine cross-source disagreement, not a data error. Overall Advanced rating retained (conservative, supported by SM Divers' site-wide AOWD recommendation and the remote/exposed character of Spanish Tower and Dakit-Dakit); manta/whale shark kept hedged as single-source, non-guaranteed.

tags.name: Snake Island
tags.qa_notes: RE-AUDIT 2026-08-21: All three sources re-fetched and reconfirmed. SM Divers and divescotty.com both independently confirm the 12-15m plateau top dropping past 60m, strong sweeping surface currents, and dozens of banded sea kraits on good days; Valm Divers (via Panglao dive sites page) confirms Advanced rating and strong currents.
